definition: Microsoft Teams live events refers to a Teams broadcast format in which designated presenters and producers deliver an event to viewers.
entry_text: Microsoft Teams live events refers to a Teams broadcast format in which designated presenters and producers deliver an event to viewers.
example: A producer manages presenters and moderated questions during an organization-wide broadcast.
label: Microsoft Teams live events
sense_note: The label is feature-specific; do not infer availability or equate it to every Teams broadcast format.
